description: This PHP class 'Composer' within the namespace 'Aws\' Script provides static methods for managing AWS SDK services in a development environment. It includes functionality to remove unused AWS service folders from vendor directory, verify listed services against a manifest, and handle cleanup with retries.

classes.name: Composer
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling AWS SDK service cleanup based on project configurations.

methods.name: removeUnusedServicesInDev
methods.description: Removes unused AWS services in development mode, delegating to the core method with a flag indicating dev environment.

methods.name: removeUnusedServices
methods.description: Removes unused AWS services, intended for production or non-dev environments.

methods.name: removeUnusedServicesWithConfig
methods.description: Core method that performs the removal of unused AWS SDK service directories based on the project configuration and environment.

methods.name: buildServiceMapping
methods.description: Constructs a mapping between service namespaces and their service names using a manifest file.

methods.name: verifyListedServices
methods.description: Validates that the listed services are present in the service mapping, throwing an exception if any are invalid.

methods.name: removeServiceDirs
methods.description: Removes directories of services not in the list, with retries and error handling for filesystem operations.
